headline: Adani Defence Tests Bagheera Vehicle-Mounted Anti-Tank Missile System
summary: Adani Defence & Aerospace conducted firing tests of its Bagheera AT1 anti-tank guided missile system at the Pokhran ranges in Rajasthan, demonstrating target engagement up to 8 kilometers.
why: Adani Group is expanding its defense manufacturing presence under India's military localization initiatives, positioning the conglomerate for domestic defense procurement orders.

impacts.name: Adani Enterprises
impacts.why: Successful defense weapon testing validates technological development for defense business units.
